Plot an explicit one-parameter recurrence quantification sensitivity slice

etr_plot_rqa_sensitivity.Rd

Inspect frozen Python 1.2 scientific plotting geometry without recomputing any recurrence, RQA or transfer-entropy estimator. Original native R plots and numeric outputs remain the default.

Usage

etr_plot_rqa_sensitivity(result, parameter, metric, filters = NULL,
  strict_source_record = FALSE, ...)

Arguments

result

Native precomputed RQA parameter sensitivity grid with declared parameter and metric columns.

parameter

One numerical parameter varied in the source slice.

metric

Existing RQA summary metric.

filters

Optional named exact values holding remaining declared parameters fixed.

strict_source_record

Return native Matplotlib scientific source artist data, requiring distinct plotted-parameter values, when TRUE.

...

Legacy base R graphics options.

Value

Invisibly the original ordered parameter/metric data frame by default. Strict mode returns a typed R source line with original source title, o marker, axes and no legend.

Details

Strict mode represents bounded source-scientific coordinates as native R records; Python dataclass and pandas domain identity, exception types, full Matplotlib Axes return, pixel rendering and independent full-source certification are not claimed.
